churches.assessment: Apostles Anglican Church in west Knoxville is an ACNA parish in the Anglican Diocese of the South, led by Rector Rev. Jack King — who also serves as Dean of the Tennessee Convocation (ADOTS). He has been rector for over 13 years, providing mature pastoral leadership. The church is known for its 'scruffy hospitality' ethos and has been profiled in ACNA communications. The parish maintains one of the richest liturgical rhythms profiled here: Sunday services at 8:45 AM (with choral music), 11:15 AM (with acoustic music), plus 10:10 Formation Hour; Monday-Thursday daily Morning Prayer (8:30 AM), Midday Prayer (noon), and Evening Prayer (4:00 PM); and a Wednesday Noon Eucharist with Healing Service. Three strategic priorities include becoming a mother church, deepening spiritual formation across all ages, and serving the local neighborhood. ACNA 39 Articles framework with male-only ordination. Strong green-rated Anglican option for the Knoxville metro.
